card.name: Linking words in hepatitis C drug lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (with, and, comma) right after boceprevir or in HCV treatment-history phrases like 'previously treated with an HCV regimen'. Also seen on a stray word after 'Zen' in non-drug text.

modes.description: The 'and', comma or 'e.g.,' that sits next to boceprevir and telaprevir in lists of protease inhibitors.
